The bug is in the `expire()` method at line 557. The condition should be `>=` instead of `>` because when `time >= link.expires`, the item has expired.

- The condition `time > curr.expires` (2 > 2) is False, so the item is not removed
- But `time < link.expires` (2 < 2) is also False, so `__contains__` correctly reports it as not in cache

The fix is to change line 557 from `time > curr.expires` to `time >= curr.expires`.
